chosen_35987.motion: continuous stride, foot lands ~1.5s / ~2.3s / ~3.3s; no hesitation or pause anywhere in the clip; from ~11s she is on the flat landing
problems: camera is at step height, side profile - never a top-down POV of one's own feet, so it reads as watching a stranger, not '내 발'
strappy multi-buckle stilettos, bare legs, black handbag/coat hem = fashion/corporate stock look; it breaks continuity with an intimate home-morning character and cannot be cropped or graded out
hard direct sun, blue sky and a monumental neoclassical building behind - high contrast exterior, not soft film-like morning light
no 'one foot lowers and stops' beat; it is a steady walk
person walks UP, opposite to the shot
cold high-key white glass hotel stairs with fluorescent light - opposite of warm film tone
harsh midday sun with hard shadows on pink stone
saturated blue jeans in frame 4.5-6.7s and again from ~17s
commuter crowd - several pairs of legs in almost every frame after 8s

decision: None of the four clips delivers a top-down POV of one's own feet on stairs in soft warm light. The chosen 35987 is technically clean (no face/text) but its stiletto-glamour wardrobe, side-profile angle and hard exterior sun would break the quiet home-morning POV continuity; the alternates are worse. Use the cream paper card fallback for f03 as the researcher proposed.
